retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: a routine election of the rotativismo, the arranged alternation of Regenerators and Progressives under the constitutional monarchy. Held 26 June 1904; the Regenerators won 100 seats. The cached lead gives the date and the seat count and nothing more, and no consequence of this particular ballot can be argued from the bibliography here. It could not be wired without inventing the argument.
